Sarah: Quick Q — for ACME annual dedicated capacity prepay (invoice 4521), they paid $240,000 on 2026-03-01 for 12 months. Need deferral schedule for month-end close. Do we recognize $20,000/mo straight-line? Any contract-specific adjustments?

Jen: Yep that's the baseline. Confirming term dates: 2026-03-15 through 2027-03-14? If so, yes $240k / 12 = $20k/mo. Need billing date alignment for partial month.

Mike: Confirmed contract start 2026-03-15 (customer on-boarded mid-month). PO shows 3/15-3/14 next year. Invoice posted 3/01 though. So first partial month 3/15-3/31 — pro-rate.

Alice: For pro-rate, calculate days in period: Mar has 31 days; service days 17 => (17/31) = 0.548 => first month recognized = 20k * 0.548 = $10,957. I'll draft the deferral schedule.

Sarah: Ok, we'll need an accrual for contract liability at 3/31 and adjust for the AR timing since invoice is 3/1. Also what's the JE we want?

Jen: Draft JE for initial invoice (on 3/1):
```
Dr Accounts Receivable 240,000
  Cr Unearned Revenue (Contract Liability) 240,000
```
For month-end recognition (for 3/31 recognizing 3/15-3/31):
```
Dr Unearned Revenue 10,957
  Cr Revenue 10,957
```
And for remainder monthly entries: recognize the monthly slice to reach $240k.

Tom: Note — we also need to check usage credits included in contract: 100k embed units/month unused are refundable? Contract says unused credits expire monthly. If they are refundable, we need an accrual for estimated refund liability; if not, treat as part of monthly service. @Jen can you confirm?

Jen: Contract says expire monthly, non-refundable. So no refund accrual. We'll just include consumption monitoring.

LedgerBot: Billing export processed for invoice 4521 (3/1/2026) — GL export ID 20260301-4521.

Alice: I'll attach the schedule to the close folder and upload to the accounting drive. Doing monthly lines with the first partial month amount + 11 full months of $20,000. Will also include a memo for auditors showing pro-rate methodology.

Priya: Q for close — do we need to accrue for any deferred costs (infrastructure) associated with prepay for Dedicated? We cap cost recognition to actual consumption. @Sarah?

Sarah: We'll estimate 1/12 of the committed hardware cost as prepaid cost amortization. Finance to confirm. For month-end sign-off, I need the schedule by EOD tomorrow.

Jen: Got it. I'll post the schedule by EOD and include the journal entries file.

Mike: Thanks — tagging @finance to review before we lock close. :thumbsup:
